note: Right-aligned dates via \hfill, a compound heading, and the graduation date in a parenthetical beside the degree while the school line carries the enrolment range. This is the shape of the resume that started all of this: it produced city 'React', state 'AI', an empty education section, and the enrolment year as the graduation year. It also carries two degrees at once -- a master's under way while the bachelor's finishes -- written on one line, which is the ordinary way to write it and the case a single flat set of education fields cannot express.
